intro.text: A being named in Hessi's Mythica, which asks whether it could be the ninth Unmade and whether it caused the destruction of Aimia.
One of the Unmade, an ancient and terrible spren of Odium, also called the Black Fisher.

items.text: In Mythica, Hessi suggests that Dai-Gonarthis may have been behind the scouring of Aimia, though her sources are thin and she isn't sure Dai-Gonarthis is one of the Unmade at all.

Odium asked the Fused El how to get more forces to the Shattered Plains in time. Lacking an allied Elsecaller or a suitable Honorblade, El said an Elsegate from Dai-Gonarthis was the only way, at a steep price. El went to the Horneater Peaks, where she linked Cultivation's Perpendicularity to the Well of Control, and led hundreds of Regals through to attack Narak.

personality.text: She wants to break and burn the world. Even Odium considers her too dangerous to unleash, and the spren believed he would never do so again.
